title: 90% IPA no longer in US stores?

posts.topic_title: 90% IPA no longer in US stores?
posts.author: Joe Farina
posts.post_subject: 90% IPA no longer in US stores?
posts.content_md:
It looks like 90% IPA is no longer available over the counter in Michigan and Indiana. This used to be for sale in pharmacies. I went to a hardware store in Indiana and on the shelf under the stock of denatured alcohol (not IPA) they had some kind of warning sign that said "meth watch." I can only gess that 90% IPA is used in meth houses? But I don't know the purpose of the "meth watch" label, because they had it for other things such as acetone.

It's too bad, but most things we need for holography will probably have to be obtained off eBay, or more difficult sources. I'm just worried that someday soon eBay will prohibit the sale of chemicals.

posts.content_md: HEET is a gasoline additive available at AutoZone type places, truck stops or Walmart. The yellow bottle is pure methyl alcohol; the red bottle is 99% isopropyl alcohol.

posts.topic_title: 90% IPA no longer in US stores?
posts.author: Joe Farina
posts.post_subject: 90% IPA no longer in US stores?
posts.content_md: Thanks, I will keep that in mind. It turns out the 91% is still available, at Walgreens for example. So far the cheapest source I've found (per liter) for 99+ IPA is the gallon containers sold by MG Chemicals which is 99.9+. The only thing to watch out for is the shipping cost, which varies a lot from one supplier to another.

posts.post_subject: 90% IPA no longer in US stores?
posts.content_md: Joe, you should have a local chemical shop that has things like that. Mine is about 30 miles away. I had to go there the first few times. Now I just get stuff shipped. I use 75% ISO because it kills beer spoilers faster but I could be ordering 99%. They also supply all my ACS grade acids.
